description: The START menu's third page (interface/mod_settings/mod_settings.py). Each name below is a key of menu_texts: the text, in the game's five languages.

line.description: The first row of the third page and the description shown while the cursor is on it. The page's other rows are the game's "- - - - -" line.

entries.description: The small list that Mod Settings opens, in order, 1 to 5 rows (the game's small list has 5). Each row has its name, its description, and what A opens: another small list ({"entries": [rows]}, whose B comes back to this row), or a screen of the code ({"title": a text, "screen": aspect_list}). All the lists together may have 4 lists and 12 rows (the code's data block).

pager_place.description: Where a big list's page number goes, x and y in the top screen's layout: the place the game gives its own big lists.

save_zone.description: Where a character keeps the mod's choices: 48 bytes at this offset of the save data (0x124E0; the data starts 0x5C into the save object and the file holds its first 0x12600 bytes), which no code of the game reads. A character without the magic has none yet. The aspect ratio is its byte 9.

value.eng: A: use this shape of picture.
value.ger: A: Diese Form des Bildes nutzen.
value.spa: A: usa esta forma de imagen.

menu_texts.description: The lines and descriptions of the menu, in the five languages, appended to each language's Menu file: the game finds a text by its index, the file's message count plus its place here, so a new text goes at the end. {slot} is filled by the code, in a row with the ratio's name.
